name: Moo2Menu
provenance: Recreated from the baked MAINMENU.LBX button labels of the 1990 game Master of Orion 2. Q,U,I,T,G,A,M,E are byte-exact replicas of the QUIT GAME frames (entries 18/19/20). Other letters are majority-consensus resamples of the baked labels at QUIT scale. S and Z are designed to match (no original S or Z exists in the baked labels); their hover/disabled states follow the dominant per-state conventions (hover: top edge 209, bottom edge 159; disabled: bottom edge 159->19).
